page.overview:
Who is Sulfur Cube?

A sulfur cube is a bucketable and passive slime-like mob added in Chaos Cubed. It turns into a bouncy cube when it sucks up the block, creating various effects depending on the block absorbed. It was announced during Minecraft Live - March 2026.

Large sulfur cubes naturally spawn in sulfur caves. When they are killed, they split into two smaller sulfur cubes, which can then grow up into large sulfur cubes.

Sulfur cubes jump around aimlessly, making it vulnerable to all sources of damage.

Sulfur cubes can climb through blocks that can be climbed such as ladders and vines. Launched sulfur cubes with absorbed blocks also has capable of climbing.
